title: First filling and emptying of pressure tunnels - Guidelines
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the guidelines and precautions to be observed for first filling and emptying of the pressure tunnels of water conductor system of hydro-electric projects.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Shipbuilding - Positioning of Ships' Round Windows - Guidelines

clause_3_terminology: First filling and emptying of pressure tunnels

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
